title: FunctionFieldNode and CoonsDisplaceNode for 2D formula displacement
description: Add function_field node: takes expression string (2D formula in u,v), resolution_u, resolution_v; outputs 2D-sampled closure. Add coons_displace node: takes geometry (from coons_patch), field (closure), magnitude, axis (normal default or X/Y/Z); evaluates field per vertex at originating (u,v) and displaces along axis. Requires CoonsPatchNode to emit _coons_uv slot with per-vertex parameters.
definition-of-done: 1. function_field compiles formula and samples over 2D grid. 2. coons_displace reads _coons_uv slot and displaces vertices. 3. CoonsPatchNode emits _coons_uv slot. 4. Integration test produces visibly displaced smooth mesh.
testing-plan: 1. cube->assign_bezier_handles->coons_patch->coons_displace(sin(u*pi)*sin(v*pi), 0.1) produces bumpy smooth mesh. 2. Zero magnitude is identity.
